description:
Enhance/upscale an image to improve quality (图片增强/放大/超分辨率). Use this tool ONLY for image enhancement and upscaling tasks.

Two upload methods are supported:
1. URL upload: provide an image URL
2. Local upload: provide a local file path, the MCP Server will auto-upload to TOS object storage

Best for images with estimated processing time < 1 minute. If the task is not completed within the timeout, the tool returns early with a task_id. Use get_image_task_status to continue polling.

image_source.description: Image URL or local file path (URL must be publicly accessible, login or signed links are not supported)

scale.description: Enhancement scale multiplier (1-4), default 2. Controls the upscaling factor for image enhancement (e.g. 2=2x, 4=4x)

timeout.description: Synchronous wait timeout in seconds (1-45), default 45. Returns task_id early when exceeded, use get_image_task_status to continue polling

type.description: Upload type: url=remote image, local=local file

name: enhance_image_sync
